def transform(g,nbhood=4,tie='first'):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    def flood(i,j):
        c=g[i][j]; stack=[(i,j)]; cells=[]; seen[i][j]=True
        while stack:
            a,b=stack.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
            for di,dj in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                x,y=a+di,b+dj
                if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]==c:
                    seen[x][y]=True; stack.append((x,y))
        return cells
    small=set()
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if not seen[i][j] and len(flood(i,j))==1: small.add((i,j))
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    offs=[(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)] if nbhood==4 else [(di,dj) for di in(-1,0,1) for dj in(-1,0,1) if (di,dj)!=(0,0)]
    for (i,j) in small:
        nb=[g[x][y] for di,dj in offs for x,y in[(i+di,j+dj)] if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w]
        cnt=Counter(nb)
        m=max(cnt.values())
        if tie=='first': res[i][j]=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
        elif tie=='min': res[i][j]=min(k for k,v in cnt.items() if v==m)
        elif tie=='max': res[i][j]=max(k for k,v in cnt.items() if v==m)
    return res
